aboutP1: Pasi iri rinoratidza machechi eKaturike, machapera, nzvimbo tsvene, mabhasirika nemakatedhiraro {n}. Zvinobva ku{a1}ruzivo rwenzvimbo rweOverture Maps{end} (shanduro {release}), runounganidza nzvimbo kubva kuMeta, Microsoft nedzimwe nzvimbo dzakavhurika.
aboutP2: Pazviri, nzvimbo {cat} dzakanyorwa muOverture senzvimbo dzekunamatira dzeRoma Katurike. Dzimwe {name} dzakanyorwa chete senzvimbo dzekunamatira dzechiKristu, uye dzakaiswa nekuti mazita adzo anoratidza zvakajeka kuti ndedzeKaturike (semuenzaniso “Parroquia”, “Paróquia”, “Basilica”, “Nossa Senhora”). Ruzivo rwadzo rune chiyeuchidzo.
aboutP3: Hapana ruzivo rwakavhurika runosanganisira maparishi ese. Ruzivo rwakawanda muAmerica nekuMadokero kweEurope, uye rushoma mune dzimwe nzvimbo dzeAfrica neAsia, uko maparishi mazhinji asati ava pamepu. Zvimwe zvinogona kunge zvakanyorwa kaviri, mahofisi, kana zvivakwa zvakavharwa. Kana ukavhura chechi, peji rinotsvaga mufananidzo wayo pa{a1}Wikimedia Commons{end} neWikipedia zvichienderana nenzvimbo nezita, uye rinodudza mutori wemufananidzo. Machechi asina mufananidzo anoratidza mufananidzo wakadhirowewa. Kadhi rimwe nerimwe rine zvinongedzo zvemimwe mifananidzo, mavhidhiyo neStreet View.
